डी (akin to 1. दी, q. cf.), i. 1 and 4, Ātm. To fly.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. डिन, n. Flying, the flight of a bird,

.
 --With the prep. [] अति अति, अतिडीन, n. Flying over,

.
 --With अभि अभि, अभिडीन, n. Flying towards,

.
 --With अव अव, अवडीन, n. Flying down,

.
 --With उद् उद्, To fly up, Pañc. 106, 1. उड्डीन, Flown up,

. The flight of a bird, Pañc. 114, 25.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To fly up and away,

.
 --With नि नि, निडीन, n. Flying down,

.
 --With परा परा, परा-डीन, n. Flying away,

.
 --With परि परि, परिडीन, n. Flying round,

.
 --With वि वि, विडीन, n. Flying apart,

.
 --With सम् सम्, संडीन, n. Flying together,

.
 --With अवसम् अव-सम्, अवसंदीन, n. Flying down together,
